_comment: Targeted mutation testing for the component simulators ONLY. These modules encode hardware behavior (bit masks, register maps, protocol timing) where a subtle logic flip silently diverges from real hardware and a loose assertion would not notice. Run on-demand (npm run test:mutation), NOT on every PR. Scope is limited to simulator modules that have fast unit tests; the rest are covered by scenario tests that need the build toolchain and are not feasible per-mutant.
